items.title: Ingrid Sertso interviewed by Monk Rowe, Woodstock, New York, August 11, 2014
items.q: When Whitney Houston died, Whitney Houston? I totally adored her. She was, for me, the purist Gospel singer.

ctx.x: Demonic. When Whitney Houston died, Whitney Houston? I totally adored her. She was, for me, the purist Gospel singer. Total purity. I cried almost every time I heard her. When she died the African singer, what’s her name, went on CNN and she said, “The music business is demonic.”
I know who you’re talking about but I can’t think of her name.
